title: MapleStory: Idle RPG July 23 Update Preview
author: Grendel
summary: The official July 23 preview announces Night Walker and Wind Archer, chapters 42-44, higher-chapter EXP improvements, Burning Field Boosters, Chaos Horntail, monthly attendance, new Colosseum seasons, and several growth and reward events.

metadata.development_status: Content was still in development when announced and was subject to change.

sections.title: Classes and companions
items: Night Walker and Wind Archer are planned as new playable classes.
Matching companions and a higher 60% featured rate in their Rate-Up Summon are planned.
The maximum level of Legendary Companions is planned to increase to 16.

sections.title: Progression and bosses
items: Chapters 42-44 add Ereve, Rien, and Riena Strait.
EXP gains improve progressively from Chapter 20, with roughly double or more EXP from Chapter 38 onward.
Burning Field Boosters add special monsters that grant bonus EXP.
Chaos difficulty is planned for the Horntail Boss Raid.

sections.title: Schedules and events
items: Monthly Attendance is planned to begin August 1 and reset on the first of each month.
Three Colosseum rounds are listed from July 28 through August 15, 2026.
The preview lists cube, pendant, attendance, new-character, Burning Field, Journey Token, Party Quest, and Boss Raid events.

notes: Original MPStorys summary and structured facts verified against the official Nexon Forum update preview on 2026-07-25.
